text.tspan: Legislative procedure – Omnibus IV – Digitalisation and common specifications (Regulation) – COM(2025) 504 (proposal)

Procedure 2025/0134(COD). State as of 06 Oct 2026: steps done and in progress are marked. Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see product-digitalisation-regulation.html).
Coreper confirms final compromise text, 24 Jun 2026
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
approves or no decision → adopted (7a); rejects
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading, or, after the EP first reading, to an early second reading.
10 Jul 2025 · Referral to committee announced in plenary
02 Oct 2025 · IMCO rapporteur appointed (Reinier Van Lanschot, VERTS-ALE)
27 Jan 2026 · Committee adopts report and mandate
11 Mar 2026 · Plenary confirms mandate for trilogues
